description_en: Revokes access permissions on a database from a PolarDB standard account
description_zh: 移除PolarDB普通账号对数据库的访问权限
kebab_example: aliyun polardb revoke-account-privilege --db-cluster-id pc-0000000000000000 --account-name testacc --db-name testdb --region cn-hangzhou
name: RevokeAccountPrivilege

parameters.help_en:
The account name.

Only standard accounts are supported. Privileged accounts are not supported
parameters.help_zh:
账号名称。

仅支持普通账号，不支持高权限账号

parameters.help_en: The database name. To specify multiple databases, separate the names with commas (,)
